subject.title: File Browser: Remove ALLOWED_FILE_NAMES whitelist, add scope levels

question: Should Control UI add workspace-wide editing and/or full-system file browsing, and what permission boundary should replace the current bootstrap-file allowlist?
rationale: This changes which files operator clients can read or mutate, and the current code intentionally splits allowlisted edits from read-only workspace browsing after prior file-read hardening.

options.title: Approve Workspace-Only Design
options.body: Use the existing read-only `agents.workspace.*` direction as the base, decide the write/admin contract, and keep host filesystem browsing out of scope for now.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Workspace CRUD
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/62417 under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368.

options.title: Reject System Scope For Now
options.body: Preserve the workspace boundary and close or narrow only the full-host filesystem portion after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Approve Workspace-Only Design
recommendation.body: Use the existing read-only `agents.workspace.*` direction as the base, decide the write/admin contract, and keep host filesystem browsing out of scope for now.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current read-only workspace API/mobile slice and have the clearest recent history on the related security/product boundary.
